cost: Gauss-Jordan O(m*n*min(m,n)) rational operations/O(m(n+1)) storage plus coefficient growth. Checker count test O(1), width scan O(m), then O(mn) exact dot products and mismatch text; shape scan adds O(1) auxiliary space. linear_form repeated variable scans/vector work can be quadratic plus delegated constant evaluation.
description: linear_form first evaluates subtrees without selected variables as exact V::Q constants, otherwise builds coefficient vector/constant recursively. Products require one zero coefficient vector; denominator must be constant and nonzero. gauss zips A,b, chooses first nonzero pivot in column order, normalizes and eliminates all other rows; inconsistent reduced rows return Inconsistent, otherwise free coordinates zero and pivot values yield Unique or Infinite. check_solution first rejects mismatched A/b counts, then any row width differing from x.len, then computes every exact dot product and collects mismatches.

inverse: A solution x admits every matched rectangular A,b with Ax=b; Unique additionally needs full column rank. Infinite particular/free output does not contain nullspace basis and many systems share it. Inconsistency strings describe a reduced row without original-row provenance. linear_form loses expression syntax and constant evaluation may leave Env effects; coefficient equality alone cannot reconstruct expression/history.
